_comment: D-819 offline badge desk. Provisioned once per desk before the event. DeskNumber must be UNIQUE across every desk — two desks sharing it would mint colliding badge sequences. BadgeKey and BadgeKeyVersion must match the API's WalkInMode:BadgeKey / WalkInMode:BadgeKeyVersion exactly, or the gates will not open the badges this desk prints. ProfileTypes is copied from GET /api/v1/admin/profile-types while online (Code is ProfileType.Code, not the Guid).
